title: Independently audit inherited P112 support and A2 bounds
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently audit the inherited global support and A2 incidence premises used by [PR #3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295)/[PR #3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931), then the chamber and scalar-extension implication. **No mathematical objection found:** on the exact declared E8/P112 labels, global capacities are 12/20 and A2 joint bounds are 20/32, hence the inherited 22/32 is conservative. The stronger20 already belongs to Nick Petalas's [PR #3280](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3280); no new numerical bound or caller exclusion is claimed.

[PROOF.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9aacf01037f6e19cabb95ccbea15fcc2965dcd4d/research/p112-inherited-bounds-audit/PROOF.md) gives a complete alternative finite check and an elementary chamber proof: the eight reflections act faithfully on240 signed roots, so generate a finite group; maximizing a checked linear functional yields the closed chamber; checked coordinate signs identify its zero roots with a face. Rational rank/kernel extension then proves the exact root-normal and D6/E6 completeness implications over every characteristic-zero field, without assuming an embedding into R or C. A fixed coefficient column's nonempty singleton class has a rational projective slope, so the all-fiber incidence bounds apply to arbitrary K-valued pieces, overlaps and cancellations.

This spells out the standard finite-group chamber argument for the assigned model rather than leaving a Weyl-chamber theorem as an external black box. It is not a newly claimed general theorem or proof-kernel formalization. No full C5, global decoder floor, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change.

This is an explicitly changed complex-rank-shape-decoder card: a user-assigned dependency audit, not a supplier construction.

All three existing analytic packages separately pass their complete registered replays here. The central ledger still records them partially reviewed; this audit does not change that status. Nearest overlapping work is credited above and [PR #3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931)'s previous common-cut/Fourier audit at33b6be488be1e9e38f2f3f9bcfc4a7db0e8a332d. The added value here is complete independent finite support/fiber verification and a self-contained chamber/field proof for its specifically inherited obligations. Entry overlap covered 650 open PR bodies, final 653, each with seven nonempty REST pages plus empty eighth, including drafts; repository helper searched2,490 local records. Latest rendered C5 and handoff text was checked. Discussion-wide refresh is unavailable without gh, and broader diffs/closed/unpublished work remain partial. No novelty certificate. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19030442).

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3/Linux x86-64, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-inherited-bounds-audit
```

Final registered replay passes both optimized, isolated commands:

- All 3,309,747 global five-spaces and 788,035 six-spaces, with complete full/live histograms and P11212/20 witnesses.
- All 1,120 A2 planes and 3,360 distinct27-root fibers. Every fiber's positive nondegenerate affine-six binding is checked. All 2,667 five-spaces and 127 six-spaces in EVERY fiber span give **8,961,120** and **426,720** contained-space tests. All 3360 hyperplane/equality tables agree. The outside-span30 implication uses a written dimension argument, not an assumed contained support space.
- All 1,920 signed reflection images, exact coordinate reconstruction, strict chamber functional, every relevant face and its rational normal,65,536 polarization pairs, root distances53/56 and actual A2/D6 plane-union histograms.
- A complete 464-small-space primal/dual oracle,6,780 binary-basis cases, four actual nondegenerate minus-Gauss counterexamples, characteristic-two and finite-field-hyperplane controls, four semantic rejections and three actual rejecting optimized CLI runs on private copies.

The exact public commit passes the 17-file committed-byte/source-history preflight and official offline export integrity check. Both actual commands pass from a committed read-only export with Git absent from PATH under -I -O -Werror -B:17.888s primary and 19.405s controls; all 18 exported hashes unchanged. Single-run timings are not benchmarks. Syntax/JSON/whitespace checks pass; no Ruff pass is claimed. An initial JSON key-order serialization failure was corrected without changing any numerical histogram or bound; the final complete replay passes. CHECKS.json preserves the development/verification limits.

[Hosted CI39210345012](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39210345012) passed on exact head **9aacf01037f6e19cabb95ccbea15fcc2965dcd4d**, completed **2026-10-19 06:34:09 UTC**. Both plan and registered replay jobs succeeded. The replay logs contain PASS_INHERITED_BOUNDS_AUDIT, PASS_INHERITED_AUDIT_CONTROLS and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; the committed-inputs-unchanged step passed. [Completed canonical finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19033843). These finite checks and written arguments are independently inspectable evidence, not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance. Full C5 and other caller/reduction premises, selected cold replay, native/physical/restoration/consumer/supplier/all-size admission, Lean and Docker are unrun or unestablished.

This uses the same donor/assistant as [PR #3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931) and independently implements checks relative to the predecessor executables; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

The smallest useful review targets PROOF.md's enumerator coverage, finite-group maximum, root-spanned-subspace rank argument and scalar extension. Further normal-plane computation needs a different actual C5 caller with its literal quotient, support/common-set budget and required dimension. This audit does not establish a new gap beyond the previously reconciled conditional69-row inventory. No continuing research reservation or construction expansion.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated opt-in audit package,11 added files. No workflow repair is bundled. No merge, closure or selected-frontier update is authorized by this audit.
